requirements.label: Clinical assured pathways · eligibility and progression
requirements.details: The route is limited to current or recent school leavers who have not started university or diploma-level vocational study. Complete the Bachelor of Biomedicine (Specialised) with the integrated major for the pathway. Meet the selection GPA by the end of year two to enter third year. Third year includes the first units of the postgraduate degree. The page 26 overview allows the recommended school subjects to be taken in first year.

source.title: UWA 2028 International Health Admissions Guide · pp. 24, 26

requirements.label: 2028 assured pathways · application dates
requirements.details: For students entering in 2028, the guide opens UWA Apply on 1 January 2027 and closes it on 30 June 2027 without late applications. The Bachelor of Biomedicine (Specialised) starts on 28 February 2028 unless deferred. The guide dates this timeline to September 2026.

source.title: UWA 2028 International Health Admissions Guide · p. 30

requirements.label: Medicine and Dentistry · ISAT eligibility
requirements.details: Submit a valid ISAT by the application deadline. Meet the 25th percentile in both sections. Only one sitting is permitted in 12 months. UWA uses the higher score if more than one valid result is held.

source.title: UWA 2028 International Health Admissions Guide · pp. 19, 26

requirements.label: Medicine and Dentistry · interview and final ranking
requirements.details: Interview invitations use ISAT plus the actual or predicted ATAR or equivalent. Final rank is 30% school rank or equivalent, 50% interview and 20% ISAT.

source.title: UWA 2028 International Health Admissions Guide · p. 26

requirements.label: 2028 Medicine and Dentistry · ISAT windows and interviews
requirements.details: ISAT registration opens in November 2026. January 2027 and April/May 2027 are the published exam windows for these pathways. The guide places interview invitations in mid-July 2027, Medicine interviews in Singapore in late July, and online interviews for both degrees in late July or early August. Offers and waitlists follow in mid-August. ISAT dates may change.

source.title: UWA 2028 International Health Admissions Guide · p. 30
